title: Can Claude replace Timetastic? 32/32 checks, 7 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Timetastic alternative, a time-off tracker with half days, holidays and approvals, from one written spec: all 32 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 7 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:51): https://youtu.be/Bx2m_GK5A24
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/pto-tracker
Timetastic pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/timetastic

Timetastic Business is $1.50 and Pro $2.50 per user per month (timetastic.co.uk/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

Music: "Chill Wave" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
